base_member_text: [L2-L3,L32-L42] (MED/reproducibility) `yum update` and unversioned package installs are used without repository snapshots or package pins, so identical image builds can change over time.
[L46-L47] (MED/reproducibility) The image clones the mutable GitHub `mmi` branch and installs it without a commit or release pin.
audit_member_text: [L1-L14,L30-L47] (MED/build-reproducibility) The image tags, yum packages, pip mmi dependency, and xbeach-mi branch are all unpinned, so identical source builds can resolve to different binary and Python dependency sets.

base_member_text: [L1,L30] (MED/maintenance) Both stages pin to the EOL CentOS 7 image, leaving the build/runtime base dependent on an unsupported distribution.

[L23-L27] (MED/configuration-consistency) The image installs OpenMPI development/runtime packages but configures XBeach with `--without-mpi`; the intentional reason and supported parallel-mode contract are not stated.

[L44,L58] (LOW/runtime-contract) The container installs the `mmi` Python package and invokes `mmi-runner` with a hard-coded port range, but does not document required input layout or how the exposed ports are used.

audit_member_text: [L40-L47] (MED/python-compatibility-contract) The runtime fixes Python at 3.4 while installing unrestricted mmi and a moving xbeach-mi branch, without constraining either package to versions supporting that interpreter.
[L58] (MED/container-signal-handling) The shell-form CMD launches mmi-runner without exec, leaving a shell as PID 1 that may not forward container termination signals to the simulation.
